name: GoogleFontsBench
description: We introduce GoogleFontsBench, the first public benchmark for classifying open-source web fonts, addressing a gap left by existing benchmarks that cover only commercial typefaces. GoogleFontsBench comprises 394 font variants across 32 Google Fonts families, a reproducible synthetic data generation pipeline (~575 images per variant, ~226K total), and a typographically-grounded evaluation metric (SWER) that weights errors by visual severity. We establish baselines using six fine-tuning strategies on a DINOv2 Vision Transformer backbone.
